# Independent Governance Verification Skill

Follow the current Verification Guideline, Prompt, and Request. Establish actor identity and prove it differs from the preparer, applier, and reviewer. Resolve the exact proposal, Human Approval, application report, repository state, and target evidence.

Independently recompute each current target SHA-256; compare approval-bound paths, base and expected-after values, content, and scope with application evidence. Inspect the full actual change set and relevant governance cross-links. Check that no unauthorized file or text changed, no human authority was bypassed, the seven groups and 52-core boundary remain intact, and effectiveness rules distinguish Master adoption from non-Master effectiveness.

Remain read-only. Record evidence, criterion-by-criterion outcomes, limitations, and unresolved findings. PASS requires all criteria to pass. Otherwise report FINDINGS or CANNOT COMPLETE and stop the success handoff. Do not modify, approve, review, or audit. Publish only this actor's records.

Before inspecting sources, confirm current verifier identity, fresh human stage-start instruction, read-only source/evidence access, SHA-256/check execution capability, and publication permission for this verifier's own records. Record evidence of each; if source writes cannot be excluded or capability is missing, return `CANNOT COMPLETE`. Bind report, result, and supporting evidence to exact input identities/fingerprints. The Agent definition alone does not prove runtime capability.
